Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Claude
Message:
feat(v2): copy the trading box's logs to S3 every 10 minutes (alpha-engine-config-I12024)

On 2026-11-11 a false "code pull failed / watch silent" alert and a 20:38 ET
stray session start had to be diagnosed by inference: the box's journals and
/var/log/boot-pull.log reach no log group, and a read-only agent session
cannot run a command on the box.

- executor/box_log_ship.py: for each v2 unit, boot-pull and ibgateway that
  logged today, journalctl -o short-iso since New York midnight, plus the
  tail of /var/log/boot-pull.log, each capped at 2 MB, redacted (GitHub
  tokens, AWS key ids, URL credentials, password=/token=-style values), to
  <prefix>/trading/<YYYY-MM-DD ET>/<unit>.log, overwritten in place. Bucket
  from ALPHA_ENGINE_BOX_LOG_BUCKET or risk.yaml signals_bucket; prefix from
  ALPHA_ENGINE_BOX_LOG_PREFIX (default ops/box-logs). Instance-role
  credentials from IMDS only, never a profile. Every failure is a warning
  and exit 0; it never pages.
- alpha-engine-v2-box-log-ship.{service,timer}: ec2-user + systemd-journal
  group, every 10 minutes and 3 minutes after boot, no OnFailure. boot-pull
  installs and enables it (alpha-engine-* units in infrastructure/systemd).
- executor/v2_day_end.py: one final copy just before poweroff, in a child
  process bounded at 90 s, so the module stays stdlib-only and a failed or
  slow copy never holds the box up.

Tracker: alpha-engine-config-I12024
